messages:
sam: Friday office playlist idea — drop ONE song in this thread and I'll add every pick to a 12-song office set. keep it spicy or wholesome, no duplicates. 🎧
maria: omg yes. adding 'September' — Earth, Wind & Fire. classic. :tada:
leo: `Take On Me` (no contest). also vote for retro synth. :sunglasses:
anya: low-key adding 'Good as Hell' — pump energy for the last hour. :fire:
jt: @sam can you make it public? would love to sneak in a request later.
sam: yep will share a public spotify link after I compile. promise no alg doom. 😂
maria: could we do a rule that if two people pick same song, the earliest wins? fairness policy. :memo:
leo: fair. also throwing in a wildcard: 'Bad Guy' (cowbell edition).
anya: @leo :( that's on JT's vibe list already.
jt: not yet. stealing it then. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
deploy-bot: Scheduled playlist job queued — ID 7742. (just kidding, humans do the fun stuff) :robot_face:
sam: love the enthusiasm. I'm compiling around 4pm PST and will post the link. if you REALLY want to game it, reply with the timestamp and your pick so i can honour order.
maria: timestamp 1709004390 — 'September' locked.
leo: timestamp 1709004402 — 'Take On Me' locked.
anya: timestamp 1709004415 — 'Good as Hell' locked.
jt: timestamp 1709004430 — 'Bad Guy' attempt.
sam: all set. playlist will go live Friday morning. feel free to DM me if you want a swap. :headphones:
maria: can't wait. will bring snacks to celebrate the first play. :cookie:
leo: rules: headphones off during chorus only. (jk) :grin:
anya: chorus singalong approved. :microphone:
jt: pressing F for dignity. :sweat_smile:
